name: Gemma 4 E4B-it
description: Google DeepMind's on-device Gemma 4 ("4B effective", 8.0B stored): 42 decoder layers in a [5 × sliding-window (512), 1 × full] pattern with GQA 8/2 (head 256 sliding, 512 full with p-RoPE); a 42 × 256 per-layer-embedding table (2.8B, lookup only) feeds every layer its own code, and the last 18 layers share the K/V of L22 / L23 instead of computing their own. A 16-layer ViT and a 12-layer Conformer bring in images and audio; tied 262K-vocab head with logit softcap 30. Numbers from config.json and the safetensors header.

summary.note: Every tensor in the checkpoint (incl. MTP / draft and vision weights), summed from the safetensors headers. Single-file checkpoint (no index); includes the 2.82B per-layer-embedding table and 55M of K/V weights that the 18 KV-shared layers never load.

Weights multiplied per text token by the main model: lm head included; embedding (a row lookup), MTP / draft heads and vision / audio encoders excluded. Also excludes the per-layer-embedding table (a row lookup) and the unused K/V of the KV-shared layers. The lm head is tied to the embedding (0.67B, counted here as the head).

summary.value: SWA-512 5 : 1 full, GQA 8 q / 2 kv (head 256 sliding · 512 full) · last 18 layers reuse K/V

summary.note: Card: processes Text, Image, Video, and Audio (audio native on E2B/E4B/12B); video = frame sequences via the vision encoder.
